title: Pharaoh's soul guided through seven palaces in the Pyramid Texts

tellings.quote: If we go back even further to the oldest religious texts we have, the ancient Egyptian pyramid texts from 2400 BC, we see the pharaoh's soul is guided by the priests through the seven areet, also called, you guessed it, palaces.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to the Pyramid Texts, which he calls the oldest religious writings we have, from ancient Egypt around 2400 BC. According to Michels, these texts show the pharaoh's soul being guided by priests through seven "areet," also called palaces. He tells it to show that the idea of a soul climbing through layered realms is very old.
